meta.title: Houston Nightlife, 2013–2025 — interactive data
meta.note: Aggregate data only. No venue coordinates or record-level rows.

venues.label: Annual ever-active venues
venues.definition: At least one month with positive reported receipts in the year.

real.label: Real reported receipts
real.definition: Reported mixed-beverage taxable receipts deflated to June 2026 dollars.

nominal.label: Nominal reported receipts
nominal.definition: Reported mixed-beverage taxable receipts, not deflated.

median.label: Median real receipts per venue
median.definition: Median among active venues with positive receipts.
median.denominator: Venues with positive receipts in the year.

mean.label: Mean real receipts per venue
mean.definition: Total real receipts divided by active venues.
mean.denominator: Venues with positive receipts in the year.

p25.label: 25th percentile
p25.definition: 25th percentile of real receipts among active venues.

p75.label: 75th percentile
p75.definition: 75th percentile of real receipts among active venues.

lower.label: Lower band
lower.definition: High-confidence in; the strictest classification band.

primary.label: Primary band
primary.definition: All in; the headline classification band.

upper.label: Upper band
upper.definition: In plus uncertain; the widest band.

ch4.definition: Share of city real reported receipts among assigned named districts; central-Houston crop; current-vintage district boundaries.

states.name: Operating
states.censoring: Censored at the panel end; no exit event observed.

states.censoring: Contains ordinary closures and concept successors; not a single exit type.

states.definition: Insufficient evidence for any other final state.
states.censoring: Censored, not imputed and not treated as a survivor.

states.censoring: Not a confirmed closure; censored in the primary risk period.

states.name: Likely closed
states.definition: Likely closed on the available evidence.
states.censoring: Censored in the primary competing-risk definition; promoted only in sensitivity.

final.note: Final-state classifications for all 8,445 panel venues. These are not observed transitions.

classified.label: Classified exit types

items.name: Ordinary closure
items.definition: A closure without a documented successor at the same premise.
items.censoring: 10 classified ordinary closures have no observed competing-risk event.

items.name: Concept succession
items.definition: A concept replacement at the same premise.
items.censoring: 1 classified succession has no observed competing-risk event.

classified.note: All classified exit types across the 8,445 panel venues. The 5 likely-closed venues are included in ordinary closure here.

competing.label: Competing-risk events

items.name: Ordinary closure
items.definition: A closure without a documented successor at the same premise.
items.censoring: 10 classified ordinary closures have no observed competing-risk event.

items.name: Concept succession
items.definition: A concept replacement at the same premise.
items.censoring: 1 classified succession has no observed competing-risk event.

competing.note: Primary competing-risk event view. The 5 likely-closed venues are censored, and 10 ordinary plus 1 succession closed venue have no observed event.

grains.name: Closed states
grains.definition: The 2,499 closed final states, split into ordinary closure and concept succession.
grains.note: Relocation is a separate final state, not part of the closed-state count.

grains.name: Classified exit types
grains.definition: Every classified exit type, including the 5 likely-closed venues promoted into ordinary closure.
grains.note: Classified exit types exceed competing-risk events by 16.

grains.name: Competing-risk events
grains.definition: Validated competing-risk events in the primary definition.
grains.note: 10 ordinary and 1 succession closed venues carry no observed event.

grains.name: Sensitivity, likely closed promoted
grains.definition: The primary event count plus the 5 likely-closed venues.
grains.note: A sensitivity view, not the primary competing-risk count.
